subject.title: fix(memory): report indexed vector store in status

question: Should plain `openclaw memory status` report builtin vector-store readiness from persisted `vectorDims` metadata, while reserving live sqlite-vec probing for `--deep` and `--index`?
rationale: The patch is narrow and tested, but it changes the public meaning of plain status from current-process probe state to prior successful index state.

options.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
options.body: Land this PR so plain status reports indexed vector readiness from `vectorDims` and `--deep` remains the live probe.

options.title: Split Indexed And Live Readiness
options.body: Ask for wording or field changes that distinguish indexed-vector metadata from current-process sqlite-vec availability before merge.

options.title: Pause For A Different Contract
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and ask for a replacement design if maintainers want a different operator-facing status model.

recommendation.title: Accept Metadata-Backed Fast Status
recommendation.body: Land this PR so plain status reports indexed vector readiness from `vectorDims` and `--deep` remains the live probe.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the live assignee on the PR and is already positioned to make or route the status-semantics decision.
